description: Test suite for Loan Management module in ERPNext, including setup of loan types, securities, disbursements, and various loan operations.

classes.name: TestLoan
classes.description: Unit tests for various loan operations including creation, disbursement, repayment, security pledges, and closures.

methods.name: create_loan_accounts
methods.description: Creates necessary loan-related accounts if they do not exist.

methods.name: create_loan_type
methods.description: Creates a new loan type with specified parameters if it does not already exist.

methods.name: create_loan_security_type
methods.description: Creates a loan security type 'Stock' if it does not exist.

methods.name: create_loan_security
methods.description: Creates predefined loan securities 'Test Security 1' and 'Test Security 2' if they do not exist.

methods.name: create_loan_security_pledge
methods.description: Creates and submits a loan security pledge for a customer.

methods.name: make_loan_disbursement_entry
methods.description: Creates, saves, and submits a loan disbursement entry for a specified loan.

methods.name: create_loan_security_price
methods.description: Creates a loan security price record for a given security and date range if it does not exist.

methods.name: create_repayment_entry
methods.description: Creates and inserts a loan repayment entry for a specified loan.

methods.name: create_loan_application
methods.description: Creates, saves, and submits a secured loan application with proposed pledges.

methods.name: create_loan
methods.description: Creates a loan document for an employee with specified parameters.

methods.name: create_loan_with_security
methods.description: Creates a secured loan linked to a loan application.

methods.name: create_demand_loan
methods.description: Creates a demand (non-term) loan for a customer.

methods.name: create_loan_scenario_for_penalty
methods.description: Sets up a loan scenario to test penalty calculations.
